room.gate_room.title: Gatehouse
room.gate_room.description: A gatehouse with a [north](north) gate and a [south](south) gate, each held by a guard.
detail.north: The north gate, held by a broad guard.
detail.south: The south gate, held by a slight guard.
npc.strong_guard.room: A [broad guard](strong_guard) holds the north gate.
npc.strong_guard.description: A broad guard, strong as an ox.
npc.weak_guard.room: A [slight guard](weak_guard) holds the south gate.
narration.shove_north.success: You shove the broad guard aside.
narration.shove_north.failure: The broad guard does not budge.
narration.shove_south.success: You shove the slight guard aside.
narration.shove_south.failure: The slight guard does not budge.
